verdict.rationale: Terminal provides a simulated card reader and API-based/server-driven integration so developers can test without physical hardware (stripe-terminal-docs-9, stripe-terminal-docs-48), which could support headless automated testing, and Stripe CLI can be scripted (stripe-terminal-docs-37). However, there is no explicit documentation of running Terminal integrations in CI pipelines or fully headless automated workflows beyond dev testing. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation pipeline documentation, evidence of unattended/headless production runs, independent confirmation of CI usage.
